blocks.text: CEBU, Philippines – Cebu continues to strengthen its position as a leading destination for entertainment, tourism, business, and leisure, with your most-loved SM Seaside City Cebu at the center of an evolving destination estate that brings together some of the city’s biggest experiences. More than a retail destination, SM Seaside City Cebu is part of a wider ecosystem that brings entertainment, tourism, sports, dining, hospitality, business events, and lifestyle experiences together, creating more ways for Cebuanos and visitors to experience the city. At SM Seaside City Cebu, retail, dining, entertainment, and lifestyle experiences converge in one destination. Its scale and location […]...
